name: Heptabase
tagline: Heptabase is a visual note-taking tool that lets users arrange cards (notes) on infinite whiteboards for spatial thinking. Its AI features include semantic search across all notes, AI-generated connections between related cards, and an AI assistant that synthesises your personal knowledge base to answer questions.
